description: This file defines the class MonkeyPermissionUtil, which provides utility methods for managing runtime permissions in the Android 'monkey' test framework. It includes logic for targeting packages and permissions, populating permission mappings, and generating permission events for testing.

classes.name: MonkeyPermissionUtil
classes.description: Utility class for handling runtime permission-related operations in the Android monkey testing framework.

methods.name: MonkeyPermissionUtil
methods.description: Constructor initializing package and permission managers.

methods.name: setTargetSystemPackages
methods.description: Sets whether system packages should be targeted for permissions.

methods.name: shouldTargetPackage
methods.description: Determines if a package should be targeted based on filters and system flags.

methods.name: shouldTargetPermission
methods.description: Checks if a specific permission within a package should be targeted.

methods.name: populatePermissionsMapping
methods.description: Populates the internal map of targeted packages and permissions, filtering relevant apps and permissions.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the current list of targeted packages and permissions for debugging.

methods.name: generateRandomPermissionEvent
methods.description: Creates a random permission event for testing based on the current mappings.
